**Wire verb `proteins annotate-go`**: Annotate a stored MetaMorpheus protein-group table with Gene Ontology terms: one row per (group, term) that any member holds, directly or through an ancestor, with no member privileged.

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `groups` (wire `--groups`) | `path` | required | — | — | A MetaMorpheus protein-group table: AllQuantifiedProteinGroups.tsv, AllProteinGroups.tsv (no quantification, mzLib \#1365) or a file's &lt;file&gt;\_ProteinGroups.tsv. Read by ProteinGroupFromTsvFile. |
| `database` (wire `--database`) | `path` | required | — | — | The UniProt XML (.xml or .xml.gz) whose GO terms annotate the members: the proteome the search used. Exactly one, because every row carries that database's sha256. A FASTA is a usage error: it carries no GO. |
| `go_obo` (wire `--go-obo`) | `path` | required | — | — | A go.obo file, which must exist. Nothing is downloaded (see proteins update-go), so the release is always one the caller chose to keep. |
| `skip_unknown_go_ids` (wire `--skip-unknown-go-ids`) | `flag` | `false` | — | — | Drop each GO id the database cites that the release lacks, listing it in unresolved\_go\_ids, instead of failing on the first run that meets one. |
| `category_map` (wire `--category-map`) | `path` | absent | — | — | A consumer term-to-category map in mzLib's format (\#!category\_map\_format 1, \#!map\_name, \#!map\_version; columns category, subcategory, anchor\_go\_id). Adds the categories table. mzLib ships no map. |
| `out` (wire `--out`) | `path` | absent | — | `.tsv only, any case (PYB-1)` | Write the WHOLE table here with GoAnnotationTsv.Write, header included, whatever offset and limit are. Written atomically through &lt;out&gt;.partial. Must not name an input; its folder must exist. |
| `categories_out` (wire `--categories-out`) | `path` | absent | — | `.tsv only, any case (PYB-1)` | Write the category table here with GoCategoryTsv.Write. Needs category-map. |
| `offset` (wire `--offset`) | `int` | `0` | rows | `>= 0` | Skip this many rows in the payload. |
| `limit` (wire `--limit`) | `int` | absent | rows | `>= 0` | Return at most this many rows. Absent means every row. 0 returns only the summary, the usual pairing with out for a large run. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `groups_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the protein-group table. |
| `groups_file_sha256` | `string` | — | never | Lower-case hex sha256 of the table's bytes; also the header's source\_file\_sha256. |
| `table_row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in the table, decoys included. |
| `decoy_group_count` | `int` | groups | never | Decoy rows (label contains D, so an entrapment decoy ED too), skipped: decoys carry no GO. |
| `group_count` | `int` | groups | never | Groups annotated: every non-decoy group, contaminants included, each once even when MetaMorpheus wrote it twice (mzLib \#1366). |
| `annotation_database` | `object` | — | never | {path, file\_type (UniProtXml), reader, protein\_count, sha256 (of the DECOMPRESSED bytes), caveats}. |
| `go` | `object` | — | never | {source\_file\_name, sha256, release (the data-version; null when the file has none), term\_count (obsolete terms included)}. |
| `skip_unknown_go_ids` | `bool` | — | never | Whether skip-unknown-go-ids was given. |
| `unresolved_go_ids` | `string[]` | — | never | GO ids the database cites that the release lacks, in ordinal order. Always empty without skip-unknown-go-ids (the call fails instead). |
| `header` | `map<string,string>` | — | never | The \#!key value header GoAnnotationTsv.Write produced, read back: go\_annotation\_format, mzlib\_version, mzlib\_release, go\_release, go\_obo\_sha256, annotation\_db\_sha256, source\_file\_sha256, unresolved\_go\_ids (only when some were dropped), counter\_q\_value\_max, n\_multi\_member\_groups and status\_&lt;status&gt;. The counters count GROUPS at q &lt;= counter\_q\_value\_max, not rows. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in the whole table. |
| `returned_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in columns. |
| `offset` | `int` | rows | never | The offset applied. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | — | never | True whenever rows were left out of columns by limit or offset. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Ids dropped from the database, a go.obo with no data-version, and the database's own load caveats. |
| `written` | `object` | — | yes: out was not given | {path, row\_count}; row\_count is the whole table. |
| `categories` | `object` | — | yes: category-map was not given | {map\_name, map\_version, source\_file\_name, sha256, anchor\_count, row\_count, column\_names \[go\_id, category, subcategory\], columns}: GoCategoryTsv's rows read back. subcategory is "category:subcategory", or null where the term reaches only the category's own anchor. A term under no anchor has no row. |
| `categories_written` | `object` | — | yes: categories-out was not given | {path}. |
| `columns` (wire `column_names`) | `string[]` | — | never | Exactly GoAnnotationTsv.Schema's headers, in its order (a bridge test holds them equal). |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | Column name to per-row values, for the returned window. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `protein_group` | `string` | — | never | The group as MetaMorpheus named it, members \|-joined. |
| `accession_used` | `string[]` | — | never | Members carrying the term, directly or by propagation, ordinal order. Empty on a term-less row. |
| `accession_direct` | `string[]` | — | never | Of those, members annotated to this exact term. |
| `accession_inherited` | `string[]` | — | never | Of those, members whose terms were borrowed: a UniProt isoform or mzLib sequence variant takes its entry's terms when it has none of its own. |
| `go_id` | `string` | — | yes: a term-less row: the group has no term (annotation\_status says why) | The term's primary id (an alternative id in the database resolves to it). |
| `go_name` | `string` | — | yes: a term-less row | The term's name in this release. |
| `aspect` | `string` | — | yes: a term-less row | biological\_process \| cellular\_component \| molecular\_function \| unknown, spelled by mzLib's own schema column. |
| `evidence` | `string[]` | — | never | Evidence codes (ECO) pooled over the carrying members, ordinal order. |
| `evidence_by_member` | `map<string,string[]>` | — | never | Member to its own evidence codes for this term; empty on a term-less row. The file spells it member=code,code;member=code. |
| `inherited` | `bool` | — | yes: a term-less row | True when every carrying member's terms were borrowed (accession\_inherited covers accession\_used). |
| `propagated` | `bool` | — | yes: a term-less row | True when no member is annotated to this exact term: it is implied by a more specific one, over is\_a or part\_of. |
| `n_members` | `int` | proteins | never | Members in the group. |
| `n_with` | `int` | proteins | never | Members carrying the term; 0 on a term-less row. n\_with == n\_members is the consensus view. |
| `entrapment_members` | `string[]` | — | never | The group's entrapment members (ProteinDbLoader.IsEntrapmentAccession, or marked so by the database), on every row of the group. |
| `annotation_status` | `string` | — | never | annotated \| no\_go\_terms \| no\_entry \| contaminant (GoAnnotationTsv.StatusName). A row with a term is always annotated. |
| `q_value` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | never | The group's q-value from the table. Never filtered on. |
| `go_release` | `string` | — | yes: the go.obo has no data-version header | The ontology release, e.g. releases/2026-07-26. |
| `go_obo_sha256` | `string` | — | never | sha256 of the go.obo. |
| `annotation_db_sha256` | `string` | — | never | sha256 of the decompressed annotation database. |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | a missing groups table, database, go.obo or category map; a FASTA database; out or categories-out not .tsv, naming an input, naming each other, or in a folder that does not exist; categories-out without category-map; a negative offset or limit. Every one is raised before any file is read. |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | the database cites a GO id the release lacks, without skip-unknown-go-ids (InvalidDataException naming every id); a go.obo mzLib cannot parse, including a truncated one whose edges name absent terms (InvalidDataException with the line); a category map it refuses; a group written twice with different members (InvalidDataException); a table or database it cannot parse |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | never returned by this verb |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- The table is the UNION over a group's members, never a pick: MetaMorpheus chooses no leading protein. Consensus (n\_with == n\_members), direct-only (propagated false) and no-borrowing (inherited false) are filters on the rows.
- Every non-decoy group gets at least one row; a group with no term gets one term-less row whose annotation\_status says why. Decoys get none.
- The header counters count groups at q &lt;= 0.01, not rows; the rows are unfiltered and every group is present.
- Pin the ontology: terms and ancestors change between releases. This verb reads only an existing go.obo and never downloads one; record go.sha256 with the results.
- mzlib\_release in the header is 'none' and mzlib\_version is 1.0.0+&lt;commit&gt;, because the bridge builds mzLib from source at the pinned commit; the commit names the release.
- An isoform or variant member absent from the database (or present without GO of its own) borrows its entry's terms and is listed in accession\_inherited; an isoform can differ from its entry in cellular component, which is why the row says so.
